newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Primetown to open second Makati "condotel".
newsitem.headline: Primetown to open second Makati "condotel".

text.p: Philippines' Primetown Property Group Inc said on Wednesday it would open its second "condotel" in the Manila's Makati financial district.
The condotel concept was pioneered by Primetown in the Philippines.
It sells condominium units to investors who in turn pool their units and rent them out to middle-income tourists and expatriates who stay in the Philippines for medium term.
The condotels will be operated by the Hong Kong-based Century International Hotel group.
The company's first condotel has a 90 percent occupancy rate, Primetown president Kenneth Yap said in a statement.

"Primetown Century tower is another significant landmark in the company's pursuit to become a major player in the property industry. We intend to replicate the condotel concept ... not only here in Manila but in key growth areas all over the country," Yap said.
